title: Sr. Workday Integration Specialist
jobDescription:
Meet the Moment with Alteryx We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision
- and Alteryx is leading the transformation. You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible. If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here. We are seeking an experienced Workday Integrations Specialist to manage and oversee our Workday integrations, including Workday Studio, third-party payroll PECI (Payroll Effective Change Interface), and Cloud Connect for Benefits. This role will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust and scalable integrations to ensure seamless communication between Workday and various third-party systems. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with Workday and deep technical knowledge of Workday integrations. Primary

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead the design, development, testing, and deployment of Workday integrations using Workday Studio, Workday Orchestrate, PECI, and Cloud Connect for Benefits. Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to understand integration needs and ensure successful implementation and maintenance of Workday integrations. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Workday integrations and ensure ongoing data accuracy and system functionality. Serve as the subject matter expert for Workday integrations, providing technical guidance and support to team members and stakeholders. Develop and maintain documentation for integration processes, configurations, and best practices. Ensure integrations are designed and implemented in compliance with Workday and organisational security standards. Work closely with the HR, Payroll, and Benefits teams to ensure accurate and efficient data flow between Workday and third-party systems. Stay updated on new Workday integration features and functionality and provide recommendations to improve integration efficiency. Mentor and guide team members as needed. Leverage Agile framework principles and follow project methodologies. Understand and ensure data security, privacy and data quality in integrations is maintained.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s Degree in relevant technical field (Information Technology, Computer Science, Software, Engineering, or related technical discipline) or equivalent combination of training and work experience. 6 to 8 years of experience, with 3 to 5 years focused on Workday integration development. Ability to collaborate with business and technology teams to create practical, robust and scalable solutions meeting the business and technology goals. Workday PRO Certification for Integrations is preferred. Strong experience designing, building, and supporting complex Workday integrations. Proven ability to troubleshoot integration issues and perform root cause analysis. Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize in a fast-paced environment. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Experience with Workday HCM and other HR technologies is a plus. Strong understanding of security protocols and compliance requirements for Workday integrations. Valued Skills: Strong understanding of payroll, benefits, and HR business processes. Experience managing integrations with third-party payroll systems and benefits providers. Experience developing Workday integrations (EIB, Core Connectors, Advanced Custom Reports and Document Transforms) is mandatory. Experience in building integrations using Workday Web services and APIs (WSDL, SOAP, REST and WS standards). Experience working in XML, XSLT, Workday Custom Reports and Workday Custom Objects. Find yourself checking a lot of these boxes but doubting whether you should apply? At Alteryx, we support a growth mindset for our associates through all stages of their careers. If you meet some of the requirements and you share our values, we encourage you to apply. As part of our ongoing commitment to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, we’re invested in building teams with a wide variety of backgrounds, identities, and experiences. This position involves access to software/technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls. Who We Are Alteryx is a leading AI-ready data and analytics company that powers actionable insights to help organizations drive smarter, faster decisions with AI-ready data. More than 8,000 customers around the world rely on Alteryx to automate analytics, improve revenue performance, manage costs, and mitigate risk across their businesses. Unsolicited third party/agency profiles and resumes will not be considered.

jobDescription:

We are hiring a Software Engineer to help build Alteryx’s next-generation Performance Engineering Platform. This role is for a software engineer with 3+ years of software engineering experience, including exposure to developer tools, automation, CI/CD, performance testing, or cloud-native systems. The goal is to help engineering teams test, understand, and improve performance earlier in the SDLC through developer-first, AI-assisted tooling. This is not a traditional QA or manual performance testing role. This is an engineering role focused on frameworks, automation, observability, CI/CD integration, and agentic AI workflows. Work Location : Pune (Hybrid) What You’ll Do Build features for an agentic, AI-first self-service performance platform. Develop reusable tools, templates, scripts, SDKs, and workflows for API, UI, service, and code performance testing. Help integrate performance checks into CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows. Build AI-assisted workflows for performance test creation, execution, result analysis, defect creation, and service-team notification. Support performance validation for Critical User Journeys, releases, and scale events. Help standardize performance test inputs, outputs, thresholds, evidence, and reporting. Integrate with observability tools such as Datadog, logs, traces, dashboards, and reporting systems. Work with product engineering, SRE, platform, QA, and architecture teams. Contribute to documentation, examples, and onboarding material for development teams. What We’re Looking For 3+ years of professional software engineering experience. Programming experience in Python, Type Script, Go, or similar languages. Understanding of APIs, distributed systems, cloud services, and service-to-service communication. Experience with automation, CI/CD, internal tools, or developer workflows. Familiarity with performance testing concepts such as load, spike, soak, stress, capacity, or regression testing. Familiarity with observability using metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, or alerts. Ability to build simple, maintainable, and reusable software. Good communication and collaboration skills. Must Have Experience with tools such as k6, Locust, and Grasshopper Experience in Python and Type Script. Experience with Datadog, Open Telemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, or Influx DB. Experience with Kubernetes, cloud-native systems, or large-scale Saa S platforms. Nice To Have Experience with tools such as Playwright Experience with SLOs, SLIs, Apdex, error budgets, or burn-rate alerting. Experience building AI agents, MCPs, AI-assisted developer tools, or agentic automation workflows. Experience with Jira automation, defect routing, or engineering dashboards. What Success Looks Like Developers can create and run performance tests more easily. Performance checks become part of normal development and CI/CD workflows. AI-assisted workflows help teams generate tests, analyze failures, and create actionable defects. Performance results are clear, consistent, and useful. Product teams can detect regressions earlier and improve service performance faster. Why This Role Matters Performance is critical to customer trust. This role will help Alteryx build a scalable, AI-first, self-service performance engineering model used across engineering teams.
